claim: Nadiad Municipal Corporation employees prepared to take legal action over outsourcing in June 2025.
label: real
source_title: નડિયાદ મનપામાં આઉટસોર્સિંગમાં ધકેલવા મામલે કર્મચારીઓની કોર્ટમાં જવાની તૈયારી
evidence_text: Employees sent notices to the commissioner and concerned officials over a dispute about including contract and fixed-pay employees in an agency after Nadiad Municipal Corporation's outsourcing decision.

claim: Kheda police transferred four police inspectors including inspectors at Nadiad and the women's police station in January 2026.
label: real
source_title: ખેડા પોલીસ તંત્રમાં ફેરફાર: ચકલાસી, નડિયાદ અને મહિલા પોલીસ સ્ટેશનના PIની બદલી
evidence_text: Kheda district police made administrative transfers involving four non-armed police inspectors, including the Nadiad and women's police stations.

claim: Nadiad municipal area still had 60 percent of pre-monsoon drain cleaning left in June 2025.
label: real
source_title: નડિયાદ મનપા વિસ્તારમાં 60 ટકા કાંસની સફાઈ હજૂ બાકી
evidence_text: A report said only 40 percent of rainwater-line cleaning had been completed in ten days during pre-monsoon work, leaving 60 percent pending.

claim: A special Aadhaar registration camp for orphan children was held at Matru Chhaya orphanage in Nadiad in June 2025.
label: real
source_title: Nadiad Hosts Aadhaar Registration Camp for Orphan Children
evidence_text: A special Aadhaar registration camp was organised at Matru Chhaya orphanage as part of the Kheda District Legal Services Authority's Sathi Abhiyan.

claim: Gujarat ATS arrested two Punjab murder accused at a labour colony near the bullet train project site in Nadiad in April 2025.
label: real
source_title: Murder accused from Punjab nabbed while working at bullet train project in Gujarat
evidence_text: Gujarat ATS apprehended two people wanted in a Punjab murder case from a labour colony near the Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train project site in Nadiad.

claim: A fake WhatsApp account using the Nadiad municipal commissioner's name and official photo was reported in June 2026.
label: real
source_title: નડિયાદ મ્યુનિ. કમિશનરના નામે મેસેજ આવે તો ચેતજો, ફેક વોટ્સએપ એકાઉન્ટ સક્રિય
evidence_text: The report warned that a fake WhatsApp account was using Nadiad Municipal Commissioner Kiran Zaveri's name and official photograph and was operated from a foreign number.

claim: Nadiad SOG seized more than one lakh rupees in counterfeit currency and arrested two people in February 2025.
label: real
source_title: YouTube વીડિયો, A4ના પેપરનું પ્રિન્ટર અને નકલી નોટોનો ફર્જી કાંડ!
evidence_text: Nadiad SOG reported a counterfeit-currency racket, seizing fake notes of 500, 200 and 100 denominations worth about ₹1.03 lakh and arresting two people.

claim: About 3,100 kilograms of suspected adulterated ghee was seized from a facility on the Nadiad-Dakor Road in March 2025.
label: real
source_title: Nadiad : રાજ્યમાં વધુ એક નકલી ઘીની ફેક્ટરી ઝડપાઈ
evidence_text: A food and drugs enforcement team raided a ghee facility on the Nadiad-Dakor Road and seized adulterated ghee and related materials.

claim: લોકડાઉન દરમિયાન મુસ્લિમોએ પોલીસ પર હુમલો કર્યો તેનો વીડિયો નડિયાદનો છે.
label: fake
source_title: બેંગ્લોરમાં લોકડાઉન દરમિયાન પોલીસ પર હુમલાનો વીડિયો નડિયાદના નામે વાયરલ
evidence_text: Fact Crescendo found that the video was from Bengaluru's Sanjay Nagar, not Nadiad or Kheda; Kheda police also stated it was not from Nadiad.

claim: ચાર વર્ષની બાળકીના અપહરણની કોશિશનો CCTV વીડિયો નડિયાદમાં બનેલી ઘટનાનો છે.
label: fake
source_title: દિલ્હીમાં બાળકીના અપહરણના પ્રયાસનો વીડિયો નડિયાદના નામે વાયરલ
evidence_text: Fact Crescendo found that the CCTV incident occurred in Delhi's Shakarpur area, not Nadiad.

claim: A video of police stone-pelting in Ahmedabad was actually a recent police attack in Nadiad.
label: fake
source_title: અમદાવાદમાં પોલીસ પર થયેલા પથ્થરમારાનો વીડિયો નડિયાદના નામે વાયરલ
evidence_text: Fact Crescendo found that the footage was from the December 2019 Shah Alam violence in Ahmedabad and was falsely attributed to Nadiad.

claim: બેંગ્લોરમાં લોકડાઉન દરમિયાન પોલીસ પર હુમલાનો વીડિયો ખરેખર નડિયાદનો છે.
label: fake
source_title: બેંગ્લોરમાં લોકડાઉન દરમિયાન પોલીસ પર હુમલાનો વીડિયો નડિયાદના નામે વાયરલ
evidence_text: The same fact-check documents the Bengaluru/Sanjay Nagar origin and the Kheda police denial that it was from Nadiad.
